model.title: Model
model.openTitle: Open the model of {name}: relations between its datasets
model.summary.few: Put at least two datasets in this project to relate them.
model.summary.none: No relation found between these {count} datasets. Open a table to add one by hand.
model.summary.fact: {fact} is the fact table: {relations} in a {shape} of {dimensions}.
model.summary.noFact: {relations} between these datasets, but no fact table yet: no table refers to the others without being referred to.
model.buildNeedsRelation: Accept at least one relation to build the analysis dataset.
model.diagram: Diagram of the tables and their relations
model.legend.marks: 1 and * mark the one and the many side
model.join.leftHelp: Keeps every {child} row; rows without a match get empty {parent} columns.
model.join.innerHelp: Keeps only the {child} rows that find a {parent} row.
model.join.rightHelp: Keeps every {parent} row, adding those no {child} row uses.
model.join.fullHelp: Keeps every row of both tables.
model.relation.label: {child} to {parent}
model.relation.title: {child}.{childColumns} to {parent}.{parentColumns}
model.relation.active: Active: used by the analysis dataset
model.relation.activeHelp: An inactive relation is kept and drawn, but not built (R-REL-13): a second date to the same table, a link you keep for later.
model.relation.nearMisses: Unmatched values one letter away from a key (R-REL-15): fix them in Clean, they are never joined by guess.
model.relation.problem: This relation no longer fits the data: {message}
model.panel.label: Details
model.dates.title: Date table
model.dates.help: A table of every day from the first to the last date (gaps included), with year, quarter, month, week and weekday, related to this table by the date (R-BLD-08). Periods without rows still show.
model.dates.done: The date table is in the project, related to this table.
model.builds.title: Analysis datasets
model.builds.body: Flat tables built from this model. They work on every page, like any dataset.
model.dialog.title: Build analysis dataset
model.dialog.body: One flat table: every row of the fact table, with the columns you pick from its dimensions. It is saved in this project.
model.dialog.name: Name
model.dialog.defaultsHelp: Descriptive columns are picked by default; keys, free text and contact details are not (R-BLD-02).
model.dialog.same: Every fact row is kept, none is repeated.
model.filters.title: Filter the rows
model.filters.help: A condition on a dimension keeps the fact rows whose dimension row meets it, as a filter flows from one to many in Power BI (R-BLD-07). Values are separated by commas.
model.dialog.done: {name} is saved in this project. Open it, or go straight to KPI or Machine learning.
model.aggregate.title: Aggregate {child} per {parent}
model.aggregate.body: A new dataset with one row per {parent} row: the count of its {child} rows and the sum and mean of their measures (R-BLD-06).
model.aggregate.manyOnly: Only for a many to one relation.
model.phone.hint: The diagram needs a wider screen: here are the same tables and relations as a list.
